title: markus ast crashes on date front matter: Object of type date is not JSON serializable

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Found during kanbus-37dd9a review. PRE-EXISTING on main (verified via git stash), not introduced by the IR work.

REPRO: markus ast site/index.md
  TypeError: Object of type date is not JSON serializable

CAUSE: YAML front matter parses an unquoted 'date:' value into a datetime.date, and Document.to_dict() hands it straight to json.dump.

WHY IT MATTERS MORE NOW: with the typed document IR landed, 'markus ast' is a downstream contract consumed by Papyrus, not just a debug aid. A front-matter type that cannot serialize means the IR cannot round-trip real authored content - and dates in front matter are near-universal in newsroom content, which is the first consumer.

FIX DIRECTION: serialize date/datetime to ISO 8601 strings at the to_dict boundary. Decide deliberately whether the IR contract says front matter is JSON-typed scalars only (recommended, and document it) or preserves richer types for the Python API while normalizing only for JSON output.
